paper_title: DART Distilling Autoregressive Reasoning to Silent Thought
caption: Accuracy and inference time on GSM8K with varying C, the number of ST tokens.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the ST Token Number C and two variables: Accuracy (%) and Inference time (ms). The x-axis is labeled "ST Token Number C," with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The left y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 36 to 43, and tick labels at intervals of 1, while the right y-axis is labeled "Inference time (ms)" with a linear scale, ranging from 33 to 40, and tick labels at intervals of 1. There are two lines in the plot: a blue line with circle markers representing Accuracy (%), and a red line with square markers representing Inference time (ms). The blue line starts at approximately 36.5 at x=0, increases to around 42.2 at x=5, dips slightly to 41.5 at x=10, then rises to 43 at x=20, before decreasing to 42.5 at x=30. The red line begins at around 36.5 at x=0, remains relatively stable at 39.2 until x=5, then gradually increases to 39.7 at x=30.
